primary_comparison: adaptive beta Fisher-Wiener lr=0.5 vs DP-SGD lr=0.5

interpretation_cases.B: adaptive 0.5 trails but 1 or 5 recovers utility
interpretation_cases.C: utility improves through 5 without divergence; the upper boundary is not an optimum
interpretation_cases.D: 5 diverges and 1 is best; the stability/utility region is partially bracketed
interpretation_cases.E: denoising improves while utility falls, separating Wiener MSE from optimization utility
interpretation_cases.F: high fallback, especially in early layers, indicates online observability limits
